I renamed `StickyKeyConsumerSelector.select(int)` to `selectConsumer(int)` in 7 files, all under `pulsar-broker/src/main`. I didn't run Maven or any build, so none of it has been compiled.

- **Interface and implementations:** I changed the declaration in `StickyKeyConsumerSelector`. I changed the overrides in `ConsistentHashingStickyKeyConsumerSelector`, `HashRangeExclusiveStickyKeyConsumerSelector` and `HashRangeAutoSplitStickyKeyConsumerSelector`.
- **Call sites:** The default `select(byte[])` in the interface now calls `selectConsumer(...)`. The `selector.select(stickyKeyHash...)` calls in `PersistentStickyKeyDispatcherMultipleConsumers`, `PersistentStickyKeyDispatcherMultipleConsumersClassic` and `NonPersistentStickyKeyDispatcherMultipleConsumers` also call `selectConsumer(...)`.
- **Left alone:** `select(byte[])` keeps its name because you only asked for the `int` overload. `PersistentDispatcherSingleActiveConsumer` still calls that `byte[]` overload. The broker-selection `select(...)` methods in the load balancer are a different type.
- **Other modules:** `managed-ledger`, `pulsar-metadata`, `pulsar-common` and `pulsar-broker-common` had no matches in `src/main`.
- **Tests:** Test sources were out of scope and weren't searched, so any test calling `select(int)` on a selector will need the same rename.

My last command left the shell's working directory in the `service` folder of `pulsar-broker`.
